  + scripts/check_exports.sh
  #!/usr/bin/env bash
  # Fails when a CSV export has a ragged row.
  awk -F, 'NR==1{n=NF} NF!=n{print FILENAME": row "NR" has "NF" fields"; bad=1} END{exit bad}' "$@"
  
  + skills/refunds-export/SKILL.md
  ---
  name: refunds-export
  description: Export refunds or payments to CSV without loading every row
  ---
  
  1. Stream rows from the database cursor; never build the whole file in memory.
  2. Quote every field and write a header row.
  3. Run `scripts/check_exports.sh` on the result before you finish.
  
  ~ guardrails.md
  - Never edit generated files under `packages/core/src/domain/generated/`; change the TypeSpec and run `pnpm generate`.
  - Run `pnpm test:unit` before you say a change is done.
  - Run every new migration twice; it must be idempotent.
  
  
  ~ instructions.md
  When the situation matches the `migrations` skill's description, load the `migrations` skill.
  When the situation matches the `refunds-export` skill's description, load the `refunds-export` skill.

+ scripts/check_exports.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fails when a CSV export has a ragged row.
awk -F, 'NR==1{n=NF} NF!=n{print FILENAME": row "NR" has "NF" fields"; bad=1} END{exit bad}' "$@"

+ skills/refunds-export/SKILL.md
---
name: refunds-export
description: Export refunds or payments to CSV without loading every row
---

1. Stream rows from the database cursor; never build the whole file in memory.
2. Quote every field and write a header row.
3. Run `scripts/check_exports.sh` on the result before you finish.

~ guardrails.md
- Never edit generated files under `packages/core/src/domain/generated/`; change the TypeSpec and run `pnpm generate`.
- Run `pnpm test:unit` before you say a change is done.
- Run every new migration twice; it must be idempotent.


~ instructions.md
When the situation matches the `migrations` skill's description, load the `migrations` skill.
When the situation matches the `refunds-export` skill's description, load the `refunds-export` skill.
